description: Start a real PageSpeed Insights measurement of a web page: the original site vs. its copy accelerated by WebSpeed Fast (mobile and desktop). Returns an audit_id immediately; the run takes 2–5 minutes, and get_measurement reads it when the user asks. If the page was measured before, its full result is returned at once. Results are published as a report page on webspeed.pro. Use when the user asks why a site is slow, how fast it is, or what can be sped up.

url.description: Page address, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/pricing

name: measure_site
title: Measure site speed with WebSpeed
